text_blocks.snippet: Yes, it is possible to get COVID-19 a second time. Reinfection occurs when someone is infected, recovers, and then gets infected again. While reinfections are often mild, severe illness can occur, and reinfected individuals can also spread the virus. Staying up-to-date on vaccinations and seeking timely treatment can help reduce the risk of severe illness.
